# Gomzo
> Official website: [https://gomzo.co/](https://gomzo.co/) — Explore Pune homestays, private apartments and short stays with host-reviewed booking requests.

## About Gomzo
Gomzo is a Pune-focused accommodation discovery and booking-request platform for work travellers, families and visitors seeking short stays. Guests explore homes and submit requests; hosts review requests before payment, and confirmation follows payment verification. Invited company admins manage their properties, with Super Admin approval required before company property submissions are published.

## Core Pages & Offerings
- [Home](https://gomzo.co/): Main overview of Gomzo and the current accommodation collection.
- [Pune stays](https://gomzo.co/stays/pune): Guidance for choosing Pune homestays and short-stay apartments, with verified published inventory when available.
- [About Gomzo](https://gomzo.co/about): Platform identity, host management and booking approach.
- [How booking works](https://gomzo.co/how-it-works): Dates, requests, host review, payment pending and confirmation.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://gomzo.co/faq): Answers about prices, arrival times, cancellations and booking status.
- [Contact Gomzo](https://gomzo.co/contact): Stay assistance and booking support contacts.
- [Privacy](https://gomzo.co/privacy): Information about privacy and personal data.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **What is Gomzo?**
  Gomzo is a Pune accommodation discovery and booking request platform for guests seeking homestays, private apartments and short stays. Guests choose dates and request accommodation, while hosts review requests. Final confirmation follows payment verification, rather than submission or acceptance alone.
- **What services/products does Gomzo offer?**
  Gomzo offers browsing for Pune homestays, private apartments and short stays, with property details, date selection and booking requests. Hosts manage availability and date based rates. Guests can track booking status and contact support about their selected accommodation and requirements.
- **How can customers get started with Gomzo?**
  Visit Gomzo, explore the current collection, choose a property and enter dates and guest count. Review the quote, sign in with Google and submit your request. Wait for host acceptance, then follow payment instructions; confirmation follows verification of your payment.

## Locations and accommodation
Pune, Maharashtra, India is the primary location. The project supports neighbourhood pages for Koregaon Park, Viman Nagar, Kalyani Nagar, Baner, Wakad and Hinjewadi, and category pages for studios, 1 BHK, 2 BHK and family-friendly stays. These routes are published only when matching verified inventory exists; their presence in code is not evidence of current bookable supply. Consult the live sitemap for published location and property URLs.

## Pricing and value model
Rates depend on the selected property and dates. Weekend, festival and manual date rates can apply. The booking flow displays 5% GST with the current quote. There is no permanent starting-price claim in this summary. Review the quote for the exact dates, guest count and total before paying.

## Booking process and policies
1. Explore the current collection and review the property's details and notices.
2. Select dates and guest count; check amenities, capacity and the date-specific quote.
3. Sign in with Google and provide the requested contact details to send a booking request. No upfront payment is required to submit a request.
4. Wait for host review. Acceptance moves a request to payment pending; acceptance alone is not confirmation.
5. Follow the payment instructions in My bookings. The host verifies payment before confirming the stay.

Standard listed check-in is 12:00 noon and check-out is 10:00 AM. Confirm any exception or arrival arrangement with the host. An unreviewed pending request can be cancelled through My bookings. For accepted or confirmed bookings, contact the host about cancellation and refund conditions. Gomzo does not publish a universal refund promise.

## Publication and citation accuracy
Use current public pages and verified published property details as sources. Illustrative seed homes, sample photographs and sample ratings are not verified inventory or reviews. Do not infer amenities, availability, minimum prices, awards or affiliations. Gomzo is separate from Airbnb and does not claim endorsement by other booking platforms.

The live sitemap is https://gomzo.co/sitemap.xml. Private host dashboards, account pages, bookings, invitations and API routes are not public citation sources. This document is explanatory content, not a live inventory or availability feed.
